content: Paulo ꞌietosimana Kini Agalipa matanaya
Ta Agalipa Paulo ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Boboꞌana Paulo, tauyo manuyo ꞌuda ona.” Ga Paulo nimana ꞌigilagasina, ta ꞌieonena gete nadigega, ꞌigwae,
“Kini Agalipa ye, batuwa yagwausowala sinabwana manuna ꞌoyo matamuya yatoolo, be ꞌigu eyaseyase me Yudia ꞌidi eꞌewao ꞌeguya manudi yada ona,
manuna me Yudia ꞌima bubuna be ꞌima egewagewanao ꞌumwalamwalatonidi. ꞌEnega yasideyo, ma imu ꞌalamaꞌiꞌita ꞌigu ona ꞌuda nono.
“Me Yudia maiboꞌadi simwalamwalatonigu ꞌaene ꞌigu bubuna, ꞌigu tuta gwamega yaeꞌalena taugu tuga ꞌigu ꞌasaya, ga muliyega Yelusalema ꞌenaya,
ta tuta dudulana ꞌenega simwalamwalatonigu ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌama boda Palisi, ta Palisiyao ꞌima loina waiwaina yamuliya ꞌaiꞌailina, be ꞌabo ꞌuenaidedi ta nuwanuwadi sieꞌisa, ꞌiabe siꞌawa ꞌaiꞌaila.
“Ta gete ꞌigu etala ꞌalena matamuya, nate Yaubada ꞌina onaupaupa tubumao ꞌediya yaemisena,
ta tauna manuna ꞌima susu site tuwelo sinuwayaina be sida loba, ga ma idi yaleyale Yaubada ꞌena silotalotapwalolo, ꞌasiyata be boiboi ꞌediya. Ga nuwayaina gete manuna me Yudia sieꞌewegu.
Ta mwaꞌadega ga ꞌimi nuwanuwa ꞌaene nigeya kapekapeyana be Yaubada tokwaiya ꞌigietoolo limadi, aga?
“Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌaboꞌagu lowa ꞌigu nuwena ꞌaene yage yauna yada toodi, be Yesu goma Nasaleta ꞌana esana yada gielosaꞌuye.
Gete manuna Yelusalema ꞌena toekalesiyao yaudi deliya yasaꞌu luguyedi, nadigega totaliya sinabwadi siloinegu, be ꞌeguma sida loemwawasidi, ꞌaboꞌagu wate yatagwatagwala.
Ta wate anuwa tapwalolo ꞌediya yagiegie ꞌelouyadi ta yagewagewanedi be Yesu sida guitoyase, ta yagamwasowala ꞌaiꞌailedi, ga yamutudi mali ꞌasao ꞌediya.
“ꞌEnega totaliyao sinabwadi siloinegu be Damasiko ꞌena yatatauya.
Ta Kini ꞌuda ꞌita, ꞌasiyata nina yatautauya Damasiko, ꞌasuoleoleya ga galewega maedana sinabwa wawasae ꞌisaema, ta nigeya nadigega sinala maedanina, ga yaꞌitena magosegwao ꞌisae sakowasiyema.

“Ga maiboꞌama ꞌabeꞌu sanamwaꞌuta baleꞌuya, ta ꞌenana ꞌebweu yanonona ꞌena Ibeliuyega ꞌieonegu, ꞌigwae, ‘Saulo, Saulo, toꞌase manuna ꞌuetalauwalegu? ꞌAna ꞌita ꞌatuwa sikwa ꞌuꞌonena, ta ꞌutootoo be ꞌuꞌausepale be tauyo ꞌuliꞌamiyo, ta saꞌi ꞌaeyo ꞌidididi be ꞌigiegieꞌelouya wawasaeyo.’
“Ta yagwae, ‘ꞌInapwana, yaita sana ꞌoyo?’ “Ta ꞌInapwana nina ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌAboꞌagu Yesu nigu ꞌuetalauwalegu.
ꞌUtooloma. Niꞌatu ꞌemuya yaapwesa be ꞌaene yaloineyo, be ꞌigu apwesa batuwa manuna be wate ꞌigu apwesa maꞌetamo manudi, ꞌuda etosimana.
Be ꞌabo me Yudia nai taudi nigeya me Yudia sitoo be sigieꞌelouyaeyo, yada ꞌetoseyeyo nimadiyega.

Manuna taudi nigeya me Yudia ꞌediya yaetuetuneyo, be matadi ꞌuda gieꞌesasedi, be guguyoi ꞌenega sida sanaila maedana ꞌena, ta wate Seitani ꞌina waiwai ꞌenega sida apwesama, be Yaubada ꞌidi toꞌumalinao ꞌida nuwataudi, be sida lugu taudi siemiseguya ꞌediya, nate taudi ꞌeguyega siꞌesasa ꞌediya.’
“Kini Agalipa, gete manuna eꞌita nina galewega nigeya yaguiguitoyasa,

ta esiya Damasiko ꞌenaya yagimi simanena, ga muliyega Yelusalema wate ꞌena, ta Yudia senanao maiboꞌadi ꞌediya, ta taudi nigeya me Yudia wate ꞌediya yasimana, be ꞌaene ꞌidi bubuna toꞌumalina ꞌediyega sida sanaila Yaubada ꞌenaya, be ꞌidi bubuna boboꞌana ꞌediyega ꞌidi nuwaꞌebuni sida eꞌitae.
“ꞌIgu guinuwa gete manuna me Yudia sigiyaigu Anuwa Tabu ꞌenaya, ta ꞌaene sida loemwawasigu.

Ta tuta gote ꞌenega ga ꞌana laba batuwa Yaubada ꞌilemelemegu, ga batuwa yatoolo ta yasimasimana, ꞌomi toloinao be tomota maiboꞌami ꞌemiya, nigeya mali yage manuna, ta tauna tuga palopitao be Mosese sigimi simanena,
nate ꞌaene Toꞌetoseyana nina ꞌelouya ꞌida loba be mwawasa ꞌenega ꞌida gimitoolo, be maedana ꞌida lelewane me Yudia be taudi nigeya me Yudia ꞌediya.”
Pesito Paulo ꞌiꞌawa kabaleyaena
Ta Paulo gete nadigega ꞌiemwaemwasala ga Pesito ꞌionatoila, ꞌigwae, “Na, Paulo kabakabaleyayo! Nai sikulu wawasae ꞌigiekabaleyemu.”
Ta Paulo ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana Pesito, nigeya yaekaekabaleya, ta esi toꞌase yasimasimanedi, nate ona ꞌaiꞌaila ta palupaluna,
ta yage getedi Kini Agalipa ꞌimwalamwalatonidi, be matanaya gete yaonaona nigeya ma igu omayamaya, ta yamwalamwalatoni yage getedi nigeya ꞌebweu ꞌikwaikwaiya, manuna gete nigeya guinuwa maꞌula.
Mwaꞌadega ꞌoyo Kini Agalipa, palopitao ꞌidi onao ꞌuemiemisedi, aga? Niꞌatu yamwalatonina ꞌuemisedi.”
Ga Agalipa Paulo ꞌieonena, “ꞌUnuwena ꞌaene tuta kukupana namo ꞌena ꞌugie toekalesiyaegu!”

Ta Paulo ꞌionalimana, “Nai tuta kukupana, nai tuta dudulana ꞌena, ꞌoyo be taudi wate gete ꞌeguya sienoenono ꞌeguma maꞌemwao walowaꞌelugu, nate ꞌebe gwausowala. Nate namo geya nuwagu be balae getedi nimaguya simiyami walobalobadi.”
ꞌEnega Kini be mwanena Belinisi be gabana be tomiyatowa maiboꞌadi sitoolo ga siapwesa,
ta sieonaona taudimo, sigwae, “Tai gete nigeya ꞌebweu toꞌase ꞌina loegesi be manuna mwawasa nai saꞌudeli ꞌilobwelobwene.”
ꞌEnega Kini Agalipa Pesito ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Tai gete ꞌabo nigeya Sisa ꞌina etala manuna ꞌisidasida, sawesawenaya be taꞌetoliꞌami.”
